data.body_html:
A Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas 2043 is the refined way to end a day on the Costa del Sol. Departing from the glamorous Puerto Banús, you’ll sail past the Golden Mile, La Concha mountain, and the Marbella coastline as the sun dips into the Mediterranean. Priced from €749 for a 2-hour charter (including skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT), this experience combines luxury, relaxation, and local flavours. Whether you’re celebrating an anniversary, proposing, or simply soaking up the evening, this cruise delivers a memorable evening on the water.

What’s included in the 2043 sunset cruise

Every charter comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The 2043 edition adds a bottle of chilled champagne and a curated tapas platter featuring Spanish cheeses, cured meats, olives, and seasonal bites. All you need to do is step aboard.

Which boats can I choose from?

The standard sunset cruise is available on our Tier A boats — the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers). Both depart from Puerto Banús and offer comfortable decks for sunset viewing. For larger groups, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) with a free jet ski included, or the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). Pricing for non-Tier A boats is available on request via WhatsApp.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No hidden costs.

What to expect on the water

Your cruise departs from Puerto Banús around 19:00 (adjustable by season). You’ll motor along the Marbella coastline, passing the luxury villas of the Golden Mile and the pine-clad hills of La Concha. The skipper will anchor near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim stop if you wish. As the sun sets, enjoy your champagne and tapas while the sky turns gold and pink. The boat returns to port after sunset, typically around 21:00.

How to book your sunset cruise

Reserve your Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas 2043 by contacting us via WhatsApp or through our booking page. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak summer months. Cancellations made 48 hours or more before departure are fully refundable. Weather-related cancellations are also fully refundable or reschedulable.

Why choose this experience?

Unlike a crowded beach bar, a private sunset cruise offers exclusivity, comfort, and a front-row seat to the Costa del Sol’s famous sunsets. The 2043 edition elevates the classic sunset sail with premium champagne and authentic Spanish tapas, making it ideal for couples, small groups, or milestone celebrations. With Boat Rental Marbella, you get a fully crewed, insured, and inclusive experience — no surprises, just sunset.
